_comment: Reference config for the ICMP carrier — multi-user (50-200) optimised.
Copy to BOTH servers, change only role, peer, local_ip and peer_ip.
obfs must stay "none". Needs CAP_NET_RAW; ICMP echo inbound must be allowed.
rate_mbps=25 ±25%  — near measured ICMP path capacity (~30 Mbit/s), shared among users
mtu=1200           — slightly higher efficiency for many concurrent flows
pad_max=96         — still breaks size signature, lower overhead than 128
keepalive=40       — quieter than 25, still responsive for many clients
mimic_ping=true    — real-ping disguise (must match both ends)
Wire settings (key/cipher/obfs/mimic/id_pool/id_rotate) MUST be identical on both ends.
